import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int B = 1000000;
    static final int mod1 = 998244353;
    static final int mod2 = 1000000007;
    static long n, cnt_var;
    static List<Integer>[] v = new ArrayList[10];
    static long[] sum = new long[10];
    static long result = 0;
    static long total_cnt;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static int mod_calc(long x) {
        long res = x % mod1;
        if (res < 0) res += mod1;
        return (int) res;
    }

    static void build_tree(int depth, int num) {
        cnt_var++;
        v[depth].add(mod_calc(cnt_var - num));
        if (depth == 6) return;
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            build_tree(depth + 1, num * 10 + d);
        }
    }

    static void compute_sum(int depth, long num) {
        if (num > n) return;
        if (depth >= 1) {
            if (num * B > n / 10 && (num + 1) * B - 1 <= n) {
                int factor = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++, factor *= 10) {
                    int w = mod_calc(cnt_var - (long) factor * num);
                    List<Integer> listV = v[i];
                    int pos = lowerBound(listV, mod1 - w);
                    long sumV = sum[i];
                    int sizeV = listV.size();
                    result = (result + (long) w * sizeV + sumV - (long) mod2 * (sizeV - pos)) % mod2;
                }
                cnt_var += total_cnt;
                return;
            }
            cnt_var++;
            result = (result + mod_calc(cnt_var - num)) % mod2;
        }
        int start = (depth == 0) ? 1 : 0;
        for (int i = start; i <= 9; i++) {
            compute_sum(depth + 1, num * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        build_tree(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(v[i]);
            long sumV = 0;
            for (int val : v[i]) {
                sumV += val;
            }
            sum[i] = sumV % mod2;
        }
        total_cnt = cnt_var;
        cnt_var = 0;
        compute_sum(0, 0);
        System.out.println((result + mod2) % mod2);
    }
}
